cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, is still preaching to the whole nation, and now he turns to the Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi. Every other tribe is about to get land in the promised land. Levi gets no portion and no inheritance with Israel. Friend, I lived in the back of a junk drawer for years, so I KNOW what it's like to have zero real estate.

cards.question: So if the tribe of Levi gets no inheritance with the rest of Israel, what do they eat?

answers.text: The food offerings to the LORD
The crops from their own fields

cards.question: Moses says the Levites have no inheritance among their brothers, but they aren't left with nothing. The ___ is their inheritance.

cards.text: Then Moses gets SPECIFIC: from every bull or sheep sacrificed, the priests get the shoulder, the jowls and the stomach. Add in the firstfruits of grain, new wine and oil, plus the first wool off the flock, and that's a benefits package that comes with a sweater.

cards.question: The Levites get these gifts from the people because the LORD has ___ Levi and his sons out of all the tribes to minister in His name.

cards.text: Now say a Levite out in some town packs up and comes, in all earnestness, to the place the LORD will choose. Moses says that Levite serves in the LORD's name right alongside his fellow Levites.

cards.question: That Levite also has money from selling his father's estate. So at the place the LORD chooses, he gets a smaller share of the food than the other Levites. True or false?

cards.text: Then Moses switches gears. When Israel enters the land the LORD is giving them, they are not to imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.

cards.question: Moses lists practices that must not be found anywhere in Israel. Which one makes his list?

cards.text: And the list keeps going: sacrificing a son or daughter in the fire, divination, omens, sorcery, spells, inquiring of the dead. I shared a drawer with a mystery key that never figured out which door it opened, and not ONCE did we try asking the dead about it.

cards.question: Moses says the LORD is driving the nations out before Israel. Why?

answers.text: Because the nations were few in number
Because Israel had the bigger army

cards.text: Then Moses puts it in one line: "You must be blameless before the LORD your God." Meanwhile, I can't stay blameless around an open bag of chocolate chips for FIVE MINUTES.

cards.question: The nations Israel will drive out listen to conjurers and diviners. Once Israel settles in, the LORD will let Israel do the same. True or false?

cards.text: So if Israel won't listen to diviners, who WILL they listen to? Moses says, "The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers."

cards.question: Moses tells Israel what to do when the LORD raises up that prophet: you must ___ to him.

cards.text: Moses reminds them they asked for this. It was back at Horeb on the day of the assembly, with the voice of the LORD and a great fire, and I bet every knee in that crowd was knocking.

cards.question: Back at Horeb, facing that great fire, what did the people ask the LORD for?

answers.text: Not to hear His voice anymore
To see His face up close
To lead them back to Egypt

cards.question: Moses says the LORD heard what the people asked for at Horeb and was angry with them for it. True or false?

cards.text: The LORD told Moses, "They have spoken well." A whole crowd basically says "please, a little less of this," and the boss says GOOD CALL, which has never once happened at any job I've heard of.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses He will raise up a prophet like Moses from among the people. How will that prophet know what to say?

answers.text: God will put His words in his mouth
He will study the old scrolls

cards.text: That prophet will tell the people everything God commands him. And the LORD says He will hold accountable anyone who does not listen to His words that the prophet speaks in His name.

cards.question: The LORD says a prophet who dares to speak a message in His name that He never commanded, or speaks in the name of other gods, must be put to death. True or false?

cards.text: Moses knows what they're wondering in their hearts: "How can we recognize a message that the LORD has not spoken?" Fair question, because I once shared a drawer with an expired coupon that swore EVERY SINGLE DAY it was still good.

cards.question: A prophet speaks a message in the name of the LORD. How can Israel tell it was not a message from the LORD?

answers.text: It does not come to pass
It sounds too hard to obey
The prophet is from another tribe

cards.question: If a prophet's message doesn't come true, Moses says Israel should still be afraid of that prophet. True or false?

cards.text: That prophet spoke presumptuously, and Israel doesn't have to fear him. We'll pause right there, friend, because Moses is nowhere near done preaching.
